function: The mask-mode property specifies whether the mask layer image should be treated as a luminance mask or as an alpha mask.

values.function: If the mask-image property is an image (an image URL or a gradient), set mask-mode to alpha. If the mask-image property is an SVG <mask> element, use the <mask> element's mask-type property. This is default.
Use the luminance values of the mask image as the mask values
Use the alpha values of the mask image as the mask values
